summary: The diff implements a dropdown menu replacement for the flat navigation buttons in Dashboard.tsx. Most acceptance criteria for REQ-1 are met: single trigger button, all eight items listed, tab switching on click, active item highlighted with a checkmark, and the dropdown closes on selection (standard DropdownMenu behavior). The admin-only Verification tab is preserved. Keyboard accessibility relies on the underlying shadcn/Radix DropdownMenu primitives which provide this natively. One minor hallucinated feature was added: contextual subtitle text next to the dropdown trigger.

hallucinated_features.description: Contextual subtitle text displayed next to the dropdown trigger describing each active section (e.g., 'Overview of your farm finances', 'Track and manage income records', etc.)
hallucinated_features.reason: The build request only asked for a dropdown navigation trigger replacing the flat buttons. The subtitle/description text alongside the dropdown was not requested in REQ-1 or any acceptance criteria.
